Relics.name: Survivalist
Relics.tagline: Best-in-slot gathering tools and doubles gathered resources.
effects: Grants the Survivalist's bag, which can store logs, fish and ores, as well as the Pickaxe of the faithful, Hatchet of devotion, and Harpoon of the pious which act as the highest tier tool for Mining, Woodcutting, and Fishing.
Resources are doubled while Fishing, Mining, Woodcutting or excavating Archaeology hotspots.
Rockertunities and critical swings deal double damage.
Rockertunities immediately award an ore.
Sprite focus gain is doubled.
Whenever you discover an artefact or lore page, you immediately gain 100% sprite focus.
Discoverted artefacts have a 50% chance to be immediately restored, and gain the XP for the restoration.
notes: The Survivalist's bag can be used to store logs, fish, and ores. It can hold up to 150 of three different types.
Doubled resources do not award additional XP.

Relics.name: Endless Harvest
Relics.tagline: Banks gathered resources automatically and keeps gathering spots active.
effects: All resources gathered from Archaeology, Farming, Fishing, Mining, and Woodcutting are automatically sent to the bank or metal bank or archaeology storage.
When Fishing, Mining, or Woodcutting there's a 10% chance for the resource to be upgraded to the next tier.

You never fell standard trees, unless someone else fells it. If a fishing spot moves you will follow it and continue gathering. If a tree is felled you will wait for it to regrow before continuing to gather from it.
Mining stamina is always 100%.
Archaeology time sprites do not move and follow the player.

Relics.name: Golden Touch
Relics.tagline: Removes Agility and Thieving failures and gives more coins and loot.
effects: Grants the Goldenhawk Boots. Goldenhawk Boots grant agility XP periodically while running, skilling, or when using ultimate abilities.
Gain Golden feathers when gaining xp in Agility or Thieving. These can be alchemised for 50,000 coins, or offered for Prayer XP.
Upon completing an Agility course lap, receive 10,000 coins per Agility level. Agility XP for the Lap is 200%.
Prevents you from failing any Agility course obstacles and shortcuts.
Never fail when Thieving. All Thieving loot is noted. Thieving loot is tripled.
Stealing from stalls and chests does not cause them to deplete. You automatically keep thieving when stealing from stalls and chests.
Safes no longer have a cooldown after being cracked.
Receive triple loot from pickpocketing and stalls (except coins). Coins gained from theiving are multiplied by 100x.
When looting chests or safes you have a chance to obtain a bundle of herbs or potion ingredients sent to your bank.

Relics.name: Crystal Grace
Relics.tagline: Unlocks every spell and gives stackable essence for Runecrafting.
effects: Grants you Seren's crystal tiara, which acts as an Omni-tiara for entering all Runecrafting altars and offers teleports to Runecrafting altars in your unlocked regions. The tiara also acts as a demonhorn necklace when worn or in the inventory.
Unlocks all magic spells.
When gaining XP in any skill: 5% chance to obtain a Crystal essence, which can be used in place of Pure or Impure essence.
Rune quantity output from essence, including Crystal essence, is increased by 3x.
Level-based rune multipliers are always the maximum regardless of your Runecrafting level.
Necromancy rituals act as having the following glyphs active whitout needing to draw them: Multiply/Attraction/Protection - 200%, Speed - 50% (Ritual speeds cap at 50%)
Light soruces and glyphs no longer require ingredients.
When burning a bone or offering it at an altar, you will gain additional XP equivalent to a Dragon bone.
notes: The Crystal essence stacks and whilst skilling you will gain Crystal essence in drops of 5-15, when consuming it at altars you will use up to 200 in a single binding action.

Relics.name: Superheated
Relics.tagline: Automates firemaking and cooking, and speeds up Smithing.
effects: Burn logs automatically when Woodcutting, without required Firemaking level. (Toggleable)
Automatically cook fish caught with Fishing, without required Cooking level. (Toggleable)
Logs are added to bonfires at a rate of 0.6 seconds per log.
Lighting just one incense stick will provide max potency for 60 minutes.
Fire spirits are replaced with Blessed Fire Spirits and spawn more frequently. Blessed Fire Spirits can spawn while smithing.
When smelting ores, you always gain double the bars. There is a 3% chance to gain a bonus 50 bars.
When smelting ores, smelt bars up to 60 times, instead of 28.
Completing in-progress smithing items will award the invention materials the item would've yielded if disassembled.
Always have max heat when smithing. Triple base-progress per strike when smithing.
Completing ceremonial sword plans gives 5x Smithing XP and 50 bars of the metal you were using. XP for burial sets is increased by 3x.
notes: The Blessed Fire Spirits can give you Stone Spirits, Uncut gems (up to Dragonstone), Charms, Clues, Coins (10k-100) or empty Crystal/Potion Flasks.

Relics.name: Divine Druid
Relics.tagline: Supplies herbs and charms for easy Summoning training and faster potion making and Divination.
effects: Grants Thera's summoning pouch, a pouch that stores grimy herbs and charms. Acts as infinite spirit shards and summoning pouches.
Cleaning grimy herbs turns them directly into unfinished potions. (Toggleable)
Grimy herbs/charms can be found frequently when Mining, Fishing, Woodcutting, siphoning or excavating Archaeology hotspots.
Grimy herbs are all cleaned at once.
50% chance to create an extra pouch per pouch created, sent directly to the bank.
All charm drops from defeating enemies are increased by 5x.
Summoning familiars which boost skills now boost them by 3x the amount.
Gain a 75% chance to save some ingredients when creating potions.
When crafting pouches, you will also make 10 of the respective familiar's scroll. Sent directly to the bank, no extra XP is awarded.
Always gather enriched memories.
Converting energies and memories together only requires half as many energies, rounded down.
Converting memories has a 10% chance to give a random porter or divine charge. Sent directly to the bank.
Memory strands are gained at 10x rate.
Chronicle fragements give 2x XP (Before League XP multipliers).
Crafting items from divine energies only requires half as many energies, rounded down.
Unlock all Meilyr potion recipes.

Relics.name: Transmutation
Relics.tagline: Lets you upgrade or downgrade resources
effects: Grants the Deities' transmuter.
Alchemical spells transmute items. (Toggleable)
Transmutation spells bank noted products. (Toggleable)
Low alchemy and High alchemy spells transform into 2 new spells:
Divine Convergence: Downgrades up to 10 of a resource into a lower tier.
Divine Divergence: Upgrades up to 10 of a resource into a higher tier.
The Deities' transmuter must be in the inventory to cast these spells.
Using items on the Deities' transmuter will display what they can turn into.
Both spells have no level requirement. The spell gives 10 Magic XP for each item transmuted. (Before League XP multipliers)
When cast upon a stack of noted items, these spells will automatically re-cast over time as long as the items are available in the same slot in your inventory.
notes: You are able to transmute the following categories of items: Ashes, Bones, Fish, Logs, Ores, Clay and precious ores, Leather, Seeds (Fruit tree, tree, cactus, herb, flower, allotment, mushroom, bush and hops), Compost, Divine energy, Runes, Necromancy runes, Necromancy ink, Ritual candles, Necroplasm and Mementos.

Relics.name: Assassin's Insight
Relics.tagline: Adds Slayer teleports, task choices, and spawns more elites
effects: Grants the Skull of Slaying, which allows you to teleport to any slayer master and a range of slayer dungeons and monsters.
When assigned a slayer assignment, you will be able to choose between two assignments.
Choose between minimum or maximum amounts when requesting a new slayer assignment.
Monsters can be added to the prefer and block lists for free.
You have the effects of the corrupted slayer mask without needing to wear it.
Elite slayer monsters are 5x more likely to spawn.
Elite slayer monsters gives 5x slayer xp when defeated (before League XP multipliers).
Monsters are captured into ushabti's 100% of the time.

Relics.name: Nature's Network
Relics.tagline: Adds fairy ring, spirit tree, and farming teleports with instant crop growth
effects: Grants a Fairy mushroom, which allows you to teleport to any fairy ring, spirit tree, or farming patch.
Patches are harvested instantly and produce is automatically noted.
Seeds planted instantly grow to full.
All patches are always treated with ultracompost.
25% chance to save planted seeds when sowing.
Herb seeds are planted at max amount, with only the base amount of seeds used.

Relics.name: Voidwalker
Relics.tagline: Gives unlimited jewelry teleports and bonus loot from Void shards.
effects: Grants an Abyssal Conduit, a powerful item that provides unlimited teleports from the following jewelry pieces:

The Amulet of glory, Combat bracelet, Delver's anklet, Dig site pendant, Enlightened amulet, Ferocious ring, Games necklace, Ring of dueling, Ring of respawn, Ring of slaying, Ring of wealth, Skills necklace, and Traveller's necklace.
Occasionally gain Void shards. Void shards can be opened to gain one clue scroll and a piece of the following loot:
Summoning pouches, Ancient summoning pouches, Divine energy, Divine charge, Invention materials, Dragon equipment, Goldenhawk feathers, Divine geodes, Blessed fire spirits, or crystal essence.

Relics.name: Animal Wrangler
Relics.tagline: Banks catches, boosts Hunter loot, improves PoF, and enables baitless BGH.
effects: Bank fish automatiically when fishing and hunter loot when hunting. (Toggleable)
When capturing hunter creatures or fishing, there is a 2% chance to receive a random farm animal, sent to your bank.
When gaining a bonus baby animal from this relic, you can instead receive an Anachronia dinosaur farm animal. (Toggleable)
When catching fish, capturing hunter creatures, or harvesting farm animals there is a 33% chance to obtain a random clean herb, or herb, tree or fruit tree seed sent to your bank.
Farm animals always have 100% stats and never get hungry.
Hunter catch channce is 100%.
Buyers always pay the highest amount of beans for sold animals, regardless of age or disease.
Hunter loot quantity is increased by 5x.
Hunter traps attract creatures faster.
Hunter marks are increased by 5x.
Fishing no longer requires bait, always catch an additional fish.
Anachronia and Havenhythe Big Game Hunter creatures no longer require bait and are twice as slow to catch you.
Spirit moths give 10x charms.
Farm animals are 20x more common from their sources.

Relics.name: Icyenic Faith
Relics.tagline: Your Prayer bonus increases critical hit chance and damage, and prayers gain a Soul Split passive.
effects: Grants you the Tome of the Icyene.
When worn: The Tome provide +50 Prayer bonus, Gain 0.2% critical strike chance and 0.2% base ability damage per 1 prayer bonus you have.
Protection prayers and Deflect curses block +50% of damage.
Protection prayers and Deflect curses act as Soul split being active.

Relics.name: Devout
Relics.tagline: Adds a 32-slot yak with remote bank access and the ability to note or un-note items, and increases all familiar damage.
effects: Grants a Devout yak pouch and the Ethereal storage scroll.
The Devout yak is a summoning familiar with 32 inventory slots. It can access the bank from anywhere and change items to/from notes.
The Ethereal storage scroll can be used to repeat the last unnote action, using the last noted item and amount. The scroll and pouch are never consumed and do not require summoning points.
Familiars which give you stat boosts also give 10 xp (before League XP multipliers) in the respective skill when gaining XP, up to every 6 seconds.
Summoning scrolls are no longer consumed when used.
Familiar spell point costs are reduced to 10% of their original value.
Familiars deal more damage based on your summoning level, up to +500% damage at 99 Summoning.

Relics.name: Perkfection
Relics.tagline: Adds two passive perk slots, 10x  materials, and faster Invention machines
effects: Grants the Inventor's Toolbox, which acts as an XP capacitor but can store 10x max charges and also charges 10x faster. It also have two gizmo slots which are applied in addition to any equipped perks. You must be using an augmented item for these perks to activate. These can be swapped out freely. Additionally the toolbox allows you to teleport to Inventor's workbenches that are available in your unlocked regions.
When disassembling items, your junk channce is reduced to 0%. (Toggleable)
Machines can be built from level 1 and run 10x faster.
Obtain 10x invention materials when disassembling items.
Augmented items and machines consume no charge.
The capacity of machines is increased by 10x.
Helpful perks will trigger 20% more often (does not stack with item level 20 benefit).
Unlocks all blueprints in the dwarven and goblin tech tree.

Relics.name: Rejuvenated
Relics.tagline: Lets you pick an extra relic from an earlier tier.
effects: Choose another relic from a previous tier.

Relics.name: Production Master
Relics.tagline: Processes production items at once and supplies skilling conveniences through the Brooch of the Spirits.
effects: Grants the Brooch of the Spirits.
Various production activities have their items processed at once.
You never burn food accidentally.
When wearing your brooch, you can spawn Seren spirits, divine blessings, catalysts of alteration and manifested knowledge.
The Brooch of the Spirits supplies infinite exquisite urns.
While wearing your brooch, you will gain portable skilling station benefits, even when not using one.
Where applicable, masterwork items now take 1 action to complete.
Gain a +6 boost to Construction, Cooking, Crafting, Herblore, Fletching and Smithing.

Relics.name: Antiquarian
Relics.tagline: Unlocks Archaeology relics and streamlines materials, artefacts, collections and excavation rewards.
effects: All Archaeology relics are available to use after completing the Archaeology tutorial.
Archaeology materials are automatically sent to the material storage, or to the bank if it's full.
The monolith provides 1,000 monolith energy.
The Archaeology journal acts as a free soil screener.
Fixate is available straight away, and no longer has a cap to casting.
Archaeology lore pages are 20% more common. This is in addition to the passive effect.
Receive 10x as many chronotes from handing in collections. This overwrites the passive 5x multiplier.
Restoring an artefact costs half as many materials.
Ancient caskets are received when completing an Archaeology collection.
Immediately reach 100% focus when you receive an artefact or lore page.
Divine geodes can be found while excavating and contain Archaeology materials.
notes: Unlocking all Archaeology relic powers includes Always Adze (logs are automatically burned for Firemaking XP while Woodcutting) and Bait and Switch (fish are automatically cooked when caught), matching Superheated's Firemaking and Cooking solves.

Relics.name: Naragi Edict
Relics.tagline: Grants a reusable Sliver of Edicts with healing, combat boosts, revival and pocket-slot bonuses.
effects: Grants you the Sliver of Edicts.
The sliver can be activated from the inventory for 16.8 seconds.
When activated, heals 10,000 lifepoints 4 times, once per 4.2 seconds.
When activated, boosts your combat stats to 255.
When activated, revives you if you die.
The sliver has a cooldown of 1.5 minutes before it can be activated again.
The sliver can be placed in your pocket slot and offers +300 armour, +14 melee/ranged/magic/necromancy damage bonus, +1,500 lifepoints bonus and +15 Prayer bonus.

Relics.name: Clue Connoisseur
Relics.tagline: Streamlines Treasure Trails with clue storage, teleports, extra rewards and unlimited sealed clues.
effects: Grants you Uri's briefcase, which can store sealed clue scrolls and caskets and allows you to teleport to any hidey-holes available in your unlocked areas.
Unlocks the Globetrotter's outfit.
Receive 3x Treasure Trail points from completing clues.
Receive an extra casket when completing clues.
When starting a new clue, it will have the minimum number of steps required to complete it.
When opening treasure caskets, you will receive the maximum number of loot drops.
All hidey-holes act as being full for the Globetrotter outfit effect.
You have 2x the chance of receiving a sealed clue scroll.
You can find an unlimited number of sealed clues.

Relics.name: Infernal Fire
Relics.tagline: Grants an Avernic star that applies Death Mark with every combat style and provides pocket-slot bonuses.
effects: Grants you an Avernic star.
While in your inventory or worn in your pocket slot, all combat styles trigger Death Mark 100% of the time.
Death Mark instantly kills a marked target once it reaches 20% of its lifepoints.
When an enemy is killed by Death Mark, you gain 5% adrenaline.
The Avernic star can be placed in your pocket slot and offers +18.7 melee, ranged, magic and necromancy damage bonus, and +15 Prayer bonus.

effects.description: All farming crops grow 5x faster.

effects.description: The Invention tutorial is auto-completed.

effects.description: Slayer points and Reaper points are multiplied 5x when completing tasks.

effects.title: 4x Reputation for Heart of Gielinor, Menaphos and Farming
effects.description: Heart of Gielinor, Menaphos and Farming reputation gain is multiplied by 4x.

effects.title: +30% Chance for Archaeology pages
effects.description: Archaeology lore pages are 30% more common

effects.title: Skillcape perks are passive
effects.description: Where applicable, skillcape perks, except Defence, are passive as long as you have level 99 or 120 in the skill.

effects.title: Bonus invention materials from enemies

effects.title: 3x Dungeoneering tokens
effects.description: Dungeoneering tokens are multiplied 3x.

effects.title: 12x XP

effects.title: 4x Rares drop chance
effects.description: Rare items are 4x more common.

effects.title: Unlock all toolbelt items
effects.description: Unlock all items on the toolbelt.

effects.title: More bonus invention materials from enemies
effects.description: When defeating enemies there's a 20% chance to obtain 12x common or uncommon invention materials.

effects.title: No KC for God Wars Dungeon
effects.description: Killcount is no longer required to enter God Wars Dungeon encounters.

effects.title: No KC for Heart of Gielinor
effects.description: Killcount is no longer required to enter Heart of Gielinor encounters.

effects.title: No Keystones for Legiones
effects.description: Ascension keystones are no longer required to fight the Legiones.

effects.title: No Keys for the Magister
effects.description: Keys to the Crossing are no longer required to fight the Magister.

effects.title: 6x Rares drop chance
effects.description: Rare items are 6x more common.

effects.title: Swap spellbooks and prayers
effects.description: You can swap spellbooks and prayers at the League Sage.

effects.title: Unlock Reaper's Choice
effects.description: When getting assigned a Soul Reaper task from Death, you will be able to choose which task you want.

effects.title: Even more bonus invention materials from enemies
effects.description: When defeating enemies, there's a 20% chance to obtain 20x common or uncommon invention materials.

effects.title: 4x Item XP rate
effects.description: Augmented items gain experience 4x faster.

effects.title: 5x Dungeoneering tokens
effects.description: Dungeoneering tokens are multiplied 5x.

effects.title: 16x XP
effects.description: Experience is gained at sixteen times the normal rate.

effects.title: 8x Rares drop chance
effects.description: Rare items are 8x more common.

effects.title: Seren spells and prayers unlocked
effects.description: All Seren spells and prayers are unlocked.

effects.title: 10x Rares drop chance
effects.description: Rare items are 10x more common.

effects.title: Unlimited Advanced Time
effects.description: The 'Advanced Time' spell can be cast without limit.
